text: Due to Construction Media has stated that they have been authorized by the owner of the property municipally known as 115 Belfield Road (the "Applicant"), to apply for three variances required to allow for a permit to be issued for one third party electronic ground sign with two sign faces, displaying electronic static copy (the "Proposed Sign") at 115 Belfield Road. The Proposed Sign requires three variances as it is proposed to be located along the north frontage of 115 Belfield Road, which is a location which is subject to two different area-specific prohibitions on any third-party signs being erected or displayed, and due to the fact that the Proposed Sign would be located within minimum 150 metres spacing distance applicable to third-party electronic ground signs and other third party signs. The Proposed Sign would have a height of 7.62 metres, and would contain two sign faces, in…

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Refused to grant the three requested variances to sections 694-22.E, 694-24.A(16) and 694-24.A(30) required to allow for the issuance of a permit respecting the erection and display of the Proposed Sign at the property municipally known as 115 Belfield Road as described in Attachment 1 to this report (July 28, 2021) from the Manager, Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building.
